topic: Hillaire spherical-shell atmosphere optical airmass vs flat-earth planar secant horizon blackout rig
topic_zh: Hillaire 球壳大气光学质量求交对比平地球正割近似地平线晚霞死黑断层
scope: Deterministic Bruneton & Neyret (2008) / Sebastien Hillaire (EGSR 2020) closed-form spherical-shell optical airmass (m_sph(mu) = sqrt(q^2*mu^2 + 2*q + 1) - q*mu) versus naive flat-earth planar secant (1/cos(theta)) and 64-step 3D spherical-shell ray marching across 17 grazing sunset zenith angles (theta in [74, 90] deg). No neural sky inpainting execution.

good_fit: Real-time procedural sky, sunset transmittance, and aerial perspective in UE5 SkyAtmosphere, Frostbite, and Flight Simulator
Explaining why flat-earth planar secant 1/cos(theta) diverges to infinity at theta=90 deg and turns the horizon pitch black
Bounding grazing horizon optical airmass to sqrt(2*R_p/H + 1) = 39.89 atmospheres via exact quadratic ray-sphere intersection
Replacing 64-step 3D atmospheric transmittance ray marching with a 4-op closed-form spherical chord formula
not_for: Overhead noon-only lighting models where solar zenith angle never exceeds 45 deg (m_sph ≈ m_flat within 0.06%)
Indoor windowless dungeon scenes with zero sky or atmospheric scattering
Neural LDR-to-HDR skybox diffusion or panorama outpainting models
Non-spherical flat tabletop dioramas without planetary curvature
